verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents separate dev, staging, and production environments in which feature flags can be enabled or disabled independently. Custom environments are a higher-tier plan feature. A local Docker Compose self-host can serve as an isolated instance, and draft revisions with approval gating help keep untested changes out of production. missing for 10: a dedicated sandbox or test mode with isolated data, evidence that experiment and warehouse data are separated from production, evidence that MCP/API agent workflows can be scoped to a non-production environment, custom environments on all tiers, hands-on corroboration.
